'''Lola Sayu''' was a [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfurous]], cracked [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was home to the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]], a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] engineered to hold [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
Lola Sayu was conquered by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], placing the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] under Separatist control.<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{SWE|locations|thecitadel|The Citadel}}</ref> During the Clone Wars, around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWA-2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] was brought to Lola Sayu and imprisoned at the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] prison known as the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] for [[Nexus Route/Legends|vital information]] he carried. A strike team was sent to [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|rescue]] him and his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] officers,<ref name="The Citadel" /> but because their ship was destroyed in the attempt to escape,<ref name="CA" /> an entire fleet of Republic ships arrived to rescue them and the planet became a site of a large battle.<ref name="CR">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref>
